name: Mobile app screen
summary: Thumb-first screens with one job each: clear navigation, a focal element, primary actions in reach, and every state designed.
principles: One focal point and one primary action per screen.
Primary actions live in the thumb zone (lower half); destructive actions are never the easiest tap.
Touch targets at least 48dp on Android and 44pt or px on web, with at least 8dp between targets.
Content respects safe areas and system bars (edge-to-edge with insets).
Hierarchy through size, weight and spacing before color.
structure_note: Top app bar (title and up to two actions), scrollable content with a 16dp side margin, optional bottom navigation (3 to 5 destinations) or a single bottom-anchored primary action.

sections.name: Navigation pattern
sections.purpose: Let people move between top-level destinations predictably.
guidance: 3 to 5 top-level destinations: bottom navigation bar with outline icons and always-visible labels.
More than 5: use a navigation drawer or a 'More' destination; never a scrolling bottom bar.
Detail screens use a top app bar with an up (back) affordance; do not repeat the bottom bar on deep flows like checkout.

platform_notes.android: Material 3 NavigationBar (Compose) or BottomNavigationView with labelVisibilityMode=labeled (XML). Predictive back must work.
platform_notes.web: Fixed bottom nav only for installable web apps; otherwise a top bar with a menu.

sections.name: Screen header
sections.purpose: Tell people where they are and what the screen is for.
guidance: Title in the title or headline role; at most two icon actions, each with a content description.
Large title (headline role) only on top-level screens; collapse it on scroll.

sections.name: Focal content
sections.purpose: The one thing this screen exists to show (a balance, a timer, a compass rose, the next task).
guidance: Give it the largest type role and generous whitespace above it.
Put secondary information below in smaller roles and muted color.

sections.name: Lists and content
guidance: Rows at least 48dp tall, separated by hairline dividers or spacing, not boxed cards for every row.
Leading icon or avatar, two lines of text maximum, trailing value or chevron.

sections.name: Primary action
sections.purpose: The main thing to do next, within thumb reach.
guidance: A full-width button anchored above the system navigation, or a FAB for creation-type actions. Never both.
Secondary actions as outlined or text buttons; destructive actions need confirmation or undo.

sections.name: Feedback
guidance: Snackbar for reversible results (with Undo), dialogs only for decisions that block progress.
Haptics for meaningful moments only (payment sent, timer done).

states.name: Empty
states.guidance: Explain what will appear and offer the one action that fills it. No sad mascots unless the direction is playful.

states.name: Loading
states.guidance: Skeletons shaped like the real content for over 300ms waits; spinners only for short, unknown waits.

states.name: Error
states.guidance: Say what happened and what to do, with a retry action. Keep the user's input.

states.name: Offline
states.guidance: Show cached content with a quiet banner; queue actions where safe.

states.name: Success
states.guidance: Confirm in place with the result (amount sent, item saved) and the next likely action.

states.name: Permission denied
states.guidance: Explain why the permission matters and link to settings; never dead-end.

accessibility: Text scales with the system font size (sp on Android); layouts must not clip at 200%.
Every icon-only control has a content description.
Color is never the only signal (pair red/green with signs, icons or text).
Respect reduced motion and keep animations under the direction's slow duration.
avoid: Hamburger menus for fewer than five destinations
